import itertools

def solve():
    # Vertices: x0, x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9, x10, x11
    # Edges:
    # e0 = |x0 - x1|
    # e1 = |x2 - x3|
    # e2 = |x4 - x5|
    # e3 = |x6 - x7|
    # e4 = |x8 - x9|
    # e5 = |x10 - x11|
    # e6 = |x0 - x2|
    # e7 = |x1 - x3|
    # e8 = |x2 - x4|
    # e9 = |x3 - x5|
    # e10 = |x4 - x6| = 11
    # e11 = |x5 - x7|
    # e12 = |x6 - x8|
    # e13 = |x7 - x9|
    # e14 = |x8 - x10| = 1
    # e15 = |x9 - x11| = 12

    # Fixed:
    # x0 = 6
    # x3 = 4
    # e10 = 11
    # e14 = 1
    # e15 = 12

    # Constraints:
    # x in {0, ..., 16}
    # All x distinct
    # All e distinct
    # e in {1, ..., 16}

    # Let's use backtracking
    import constraint
    problem = constraint.Problem()
    problem.addVariables(range(12), range(17))
    problem.addConstraint(constraint.AllDifferentConstraint(), range(12))

    # Fixed values
    problem.addConstraint(lambda x0: x0 == 6, [0])
    problem.addConstraint(lambda x3: x3 == 4, [3])

    # Edges
    def edge_constraint(x_a, x_b, e_val):
        return abs(x_a - x_b) == e_val

    # e10 = |x4 - x6| = 11
    problem.addConstraint(lambda x4, x6: abs(x4 - x6) == 11, [4, 6])
    # e14 = |x8 - x10| = 1
    problem.addConstraint(lambda x8, x10: abs(x8 - x10) == 1, [8, 10])
    # e15 = |x9 - x11| = 12
    problem.addConstraint(lambda x9, x11: abs(x9 - x11) == 12, [9, 11])

    # All edges must be distinct and in {1, ..., 16}
    def all_edges_distinct(*vars):
        x0, x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9, x10, x11 = vars
        edges = [
            abs(x0 - x1), abs(x2 - x3), abs(x4 - x5), abs(x6 - x7), abs(x8 - x9), abs(x10 - x11),
            abs(x0 - x2), abs(x1 - x3), abs(x2 - x4), abs(x3 - x5), abs(x4 - x6), abs(x5 - x7),
            abs(x6 - x8), abs(x7 - x9), abs(x8 - x10), abs(x9 - x11)
        ]
        if len(set(edges)) != 16:
            return False
        if any(e < 1 or e > 16 for e in edges):
            return False
        return True

    problem.addConstraint(all_edges_distinct, range(12))

    solution = problem.getSolution()
    return solution
